questions.content: Sugar which does not give reddish brown precipitate with Fehling's reagent, is :

en.content: Sugar which does not give reddish brown precipitate with Fehling's reagent, is :
en.explanation:
Sucrose do not contain hemiacetal group.

Hence it does not give test with Fehling solution.

While all other give positive test with Fehling solution
